$comment: Release notes the app reads (045). Every version has an entry (a one-line title is enough; CI fails without it). breaking: true = the update cannot be applied without the owner's decision (automatic updates stop before it). data: migrated | not-migrated | unchanged. Read from the target release tag with `git show <tag>:releases.json`. See docs/upgrading.md and AGENTS.md (Definition of Done).

2.24.0.title: The panel opens faster: Overview first, other screens when you open them, only changed files after an update
2.24.0.summary: The panel is now split into small files your browser keeps: Overview needs about half the download it did and one round trip less, so it shows up to a third sooner on a slow phone connection; each other screen loads the first time you open it, and after an update only the files that changed are downloaded again. The page also runs only scripts from your own server (a stricter browser security policy). Everything looks and works as before. Nothing to do on your server.

2.23.0.title: Getting started opens each first step right on Overview, and / finds any agent, chat or setting
2.23.0.summary: A new owner links WhatsApp, pastes any model key (it is recognised) or starts free, taps a template, switches a group on and sends a test without leaving Overview; steps can be skipped, and the card ends with the test answer. The built-in owner assistant no longer counts as your first agent. Press / or ⌘K (the search button on a phone) to jump to any agent, chat, setting or action. Tabs are in everyday order, Pending shows only while something waits, Secrets moved into Settings (old links still work), Settings has a section index, and choosing an agent for a chat that is off switches it on. Nothing to do on your server.

2.22.0.title: The panel is your phone app: install it on the home screen; the preview mobile app (Expo Go) is gone
2.22.0.summary: Open the panel on your phone and add it to the home screen (Overview shows how, or an Install button): it opens full screen with the Duniya icon, live status, Ask and confirmations, and form fields no longer zoom on iPhone. The preview mobile app that ran in Expo Go was removed with Settings → Mobile app; phones that were signed in to it are signed out, and the panel API now accepts only the panel's own sign-in. Connected AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) are not affected. Nothing to do on your server.

2.21.0.title: No secrets in chats: keys are entered on one-time panel links, new users set their own password, restores use the stored passphrase
2.21.0.summary: The owner assistant (WhatsApp and the Ask box) and AI assistants can now set keys, add users and restore backups without ever seeing a secret. set_secret returns a one-time link (15 minutes) where a signed-in owner or admin pastes the value; add_user creates the person with a one-time sign-up link (48 hours) where they choose their own password; restore_backup uses this server's stored backup passphrase. A key or password pasted into the owner assistant is not read, stored or sent to the AI. AI assistants that passed a value to set_secret or a password to add_user now get a link instead.

2.20.0.title: The owner assistant is your own super agent: a built-in agent with its own editor, tools, GIFs, photos & voice, and sends into your chats after you confirm
2.20.0.summary: In your own WhatsApp chat the owner assistant now has everything an agent has: global tool services ("send me a gif"), WhatsApp actions, photos, PDFs and voice notes, voice replies, pictures and memory. Owners and admins can have it send messages, GIFs, polls and more into chats that are on, always after confirm CODE. It is a built-in agent (Agents → Owner assistant): give it a character, choose its tools and model, and add scheduled messages to you. The weekly summary is now one of its schedules and the alert number is in its Alerts section: enter the number there again, and set the model again if you had chosen one.

2.19.2.title: Member tags no longer looked for in the group member list (WhatsApp does not put them there); smaller WhatsApp code

2.19.1.title: Faster panel (compressed page, live status instead of polling, quicker screen switches) and a leaner code base
2.19.1.summary: The panel page is sent compressed and cached, the status arrives live instead of every 5 seconds, and switching screens reuses what was just loaded. Old upgrade code from earlier versions was removed: agent models must be named with their account (auto or account:model), as the panel always does.

2.19.0.title: Agents use the names from your phone contacts (profile names are often incomplete); owner can switch this off on the Contacts page

2.18.0.title: Names instead of numbers, group member tags, and automatic retries
2.18.0.summary: The panel shows people by the name you gave them, then your phone contact name, business name or profile name, instead of numbers; a profile-name change no longer replaces your contact name, and people WhatsApp shows only by a hidden id get their name once the number is known. Contact names refresh by themselves (one full refresh after this update, then daily). Group member tags ("Driver") show next to names and agents see them, for chats that are on. Loading recent messages retries by itself when your phone was offline. Existing synced names start as profile names until the first refresh brings back your contact names.

2.17.1.title: Activity log names only the agent settings that actually changed (old → new for short values)

2.17.0.title: Small server mode in Settings → Server; local tool services refused on small servers everywhere; the maintenance helper updates itself
2.17.0.summary: On a small server (1 GB / 1 CPU) local tool services are now refused on every path, not only in Browse; ones saved before stay but are not started. One switch, Small server mode (Settings → Server, owner), allows on-server speech and local tool services anyway (moved from Photos & voice; your setting is kept). The root maintenance helper now updates itself from the release after an app update (or Update maintenance helper on the Server page). Servers whose helper predates 2.17 need one sudo duniya update (or a reinstall without SSH) to get this.

2.16.0.title: Quick replies, welcome messages and FAQ answers without AI; code plugins removed
2.16.0.summary: Agents can answer commands like !rides or !rules, greet new group members once (with the group rules) and answer clear FAQ matches from text you write: no AI, no tokens (agent editor → Quick replies, welcome & FAQ; per-group welcome override on Chats). The templates include !rules, !help and a welcome. The optional code plugins (the plugins/ folder, example-dice) are gone; nobody used them. An agent that still lists a plugin keeps working: the setting is dropped on the next save. For extra tools, add an MCP tool service.

2.10.0.title: Confirm codes and provider pauses survive restarts; photos never go to a model that can't see them
2.10.0.summary: Pending confirm codes (owner assistant, admin MCP) and provider pauses are kept across restarts and updates. When a model fails on a photo, fallback only moves to models that can see images (then the vision fallback model); otherwise the agent answers without the photo and says so.

2.9.0.title: Breaking releases need your confirmation
2.9.0.summary: Automatic updates install only releases that need no action and stop before a breaking one. You are asked on the panel and on WhatsApp (alert number, or the owner assistant with a confirm code). A local backup is made before every update when a backup passphrase is set.

2.7.0.title: Photos & voice need ffmpeg
2.7.0.summary: Voice replies and on-server speech use ffmpeg and bzip2. Servers installed before 2.7.0 do not have them; everything else keeps working.
actions: To use voice replies or on-server speech: run the installer once more (it adds ffmpeg and bzip2), or `sudo apt install ffmpeg bzip2`. Docker images include them.

2.5.0.title: Web address & access: any proxy, safe switching
2.5.0.summary: Access can be limited to any supported proxy, not only Cloudflare, and domain changes are done in safe steps. The old "Cloudflare only" setting is not carried over (the web server keeps its applied configuration until you apply a change), and the root maintenance helper of older installs does not know the new options.
actions: Run the installer once more so the root maintenance helper understands the new web settings.
If you limited access to Cloudflare: open Settings → Web address & access, choose Cloudflare again and apply.

2.0.0.title: Bots are now agents (fresh install)
2.0.0.summary: 2.0 renamed bots to agents everywhere: database tables, settings, API paths (/api/agents), admin MCP tool names (create_agent) and export files (duniya-agent). There is no migration: a 1.x database, a 1.x backup or a 1.x agent export cannot be used.
actions: Reinstall from scratch on a fresh server (or remove the data directory) and link WhatsApp again.
Set your agents up again (templates and the AI helper make this quick).
Update scripts and AI assistants that call /api/bots or bot tool names to the agent names.

2.9.2.title: Install: clearer web server start
2.9.2.summary: The installer waits for port 80 to be free before starting the web server, retries once, and shows the web server's own error if it still fails.

2.9.1.title: Clearer first install
2.9.1.summary: The install progress page stays live until the final web server is ready and comes back with the error if the install fails; ffmpeg installs after the panel is up; one-click buttons open in a new tab.

2.9.3.title: Visual docs
2.9.3.summary: README and guides rewritten as short, visual pages with diagrams, screenshots and clear next steps; a link check keeps them connected.

2.9.4.title: Diagrams show everywhere
2.9.4.summary: Docs diagrams are now images with a text version, so they show on github.com, in the GitHub mobile app and on phones. Nothing changes on your server.

2.9.5.title: Install fix: web server could not read its config
2.9.5.summary: Fresh installs failed at 'Setting up HTTPS' because the web server's config file was written unreadable for the web server (installer umask 027). Fixed; redeploy to pick it up.

2.9.6.title: Sign-in fixes: Google on every panel address, ChatGPT paste on iPad
2.9.6.summary: Sign in with Google now returns to the panel address you started on, so it works on a new domain or alias once that address is registered in Google Cloud. The panel lists the exact origins (no slash at the end) and redirect URIs for every address, shows them while you change the domain, and explains a sign-in that came back to another address. The Sign in with ChatGPT paste also accepts the address without http:// (as iPad Safari copies it).
actions: Using Sign in with Google with more than one panel address (or changing the domain)? Add every origin and redirect URI shown under Settings → Sign in with Google to your OAuth client in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.

2.9.7.title: Security housekeeping
2.9.7.summary: Mobile app tooling uses a patched minimatch; console log lines can no longer be split by message text.

2.9.8.title: Security fixes
2.9.8.summary: Fixed CodeQL findings: linear-time bearer token parsing, race-free creation of the master key and setup code, and result pages that redirect without inline scripts.

2.11.0.title: Streaming Ask box, per-chat fallback editor, friendlier mobile app
2.11.0.summary: The Ask box (panel and mobile app) shows each step and the assistant's text as it works. Chats → Fallback… edits a chat's own ordered list of models. The mobile app shows AI-proposed changes as a word-level diff and has the chat privacy settings and the owner assistant link.

2.11.1.title: Security alerts handled automatically
2.11.1.summary: Reviewed false-positive code-scanning alerts are dismissed automatically from a reviewed list; real findings are fixed in code.

2.11.2.title: Mobile demo fix
2.11.2.summary: The mobile app's demo mode shows the Ask box's final answer again (a missing await, found by code scanning).

2.12.0.title: The Ask box writes its answer word by word
2.12.0.summary: In the panel and the mobile app, the owner assistant's text now appears as the model writes it (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, other OpenAI-compatible endpoints, ChatGPT; GitHub Copilot still shows it after each step). If a stream breaks half-way, the partial text is replaced by a fresh answer; fallback to other models works as before. WhatsApp replies are unchanged.

2.12.1.title: Switching a chat on loads its recent messages from your phone
2.12.1.summary: Chats that are off still store no messages (only the id and time of the newest one). When you switch a chat on, its recent messages (50 by default) are loaded from your phone and summarised, so the agent starts with context; keep the phone online. Chats → “Load recent messages” asks again or goes further back. Agents now say plainly what history they have.

2.13.0.title: Triggers work anywhere in a message
2.13.0.summary: "can mochi help?" now wakes the agent whose trigger is mochi; only whole words count. A trigger at the start is still removed from what the agent reads.

2.13.1.title: Plugin help text
2.13.1.summary: The agent editor explains what plugins are and that example-dice is a developer sample; docs point to MCP tool services for ready-made tools.

2.14.0.title: Set up a person's chat before they write
2.14.0.summary: Chats → Add a direct chat (or Contacts → Set up chat) assigns an agent, on/off, private, model and caps to a phone number before any message; their first message goes to that agent, whichever form WhatsApp uses. The owner assistant does it in one go ("assign Mochi to Vedika"). The agent can send an intro, only after you confirm.

2.15.0.title: Browse tool services: add an MCP server from the MCP Registry in one click
2.15.0.summary: Agents → Tool services and Settings → Tool services get Browse tool services: search the official MCP Registry (or a private one), see the publisher, hosted or local, keys needed and a trust hint, and add it with keys stored as secrets. Tools are listed right away with organizers on and participants off. Local packages are owner-only and refused on small servers.

2.15.1.title: OS updates install new kernels, explain gradual Ubuntu roll-outs and ask for a restart
2.15.1.summary: Install OS updates now uses apt full-upgrade (kept-back kernel packages install) and removes packages no longer needed. The Server page groups updates (will install / rolling out gradually / held back with the reason), offers Include gradual updates now, shows a one-line result and a Restart needed banner. Run sudo duniya update on the server once (or re-run the installer): the in-panel update cannot refresh the root maintenance helper.
actions: Run sudo duniya update on the server once (or re-run the installer) so the maintenance helper is refreshed
